definitions.short: to stun , i.e. stupefy (with sleep or death)
definitions.usage: (be fast a-, be in a deep, cast into a dead, that) sleep(-er, -eth).
definitions.full: H7290. radam [ רָדַם ] verb Niph`al be in, or fall into, heavy sleep (Late Hebrew id. ; compare Arabic stop up (door, gap, etc.), whence perhaps be deaf (stopped up) to sounds, etc.); — Perfect 3masculine singular נִרְדַּם Judg 4:21 ; 1 singular נִרְדַּמְתִּי Dan 8:8 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיֵּרָדֵם Jonah 1:5 ; Participle נִרְדָּם Prov 10:5 3 t.; — be or fall fast asleep: Judg 4:21 ; Jonah 1:5 (after וַיִּשְׁכַב ), 1:6 (participle, Ges § 120b Da Synt. § 70 (a)); participle as substantive בַּקָּצִיר נִרְדָּם Prov 10:5 ; of sleep of death Psa 76:7 ; stunning effect of awe and dread Dan 8:18 ; 10:9 (both + אָ֑רְצָה [ וּפָנַי ] עַלמָּֿנַי .
